name.text: Calculating the combined mean and standard deviation for two datasets presented as dotplots

questiontext.text:
If two or more groups of values with different means and standard deviations are combined, you should be able to anticipate the effect on the mean and standard deviation.

Plastic containers are manufactured by two machines whose settings are often different. The stacked dot plots below describe component lengths from the three machines. What are the mean and standard deviation of the combined data set?

[[jsxgraph]] // Create empty list of points var p = []; // Create board var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [{#xmin#}, {#ymax#}, {#xmax#}, {#ymin#}], keepaspectratio: false, showCopyright: false, axis:true }); //Create points of Data Set 2 var lx2 = {#dorx2#}; var ly2 = {#dory2#}; var i = 0; for (i = 0; i <= lx2.length - 1; i++) { p[i] = board.create('point', [lx2[i], ly2[i]], { face: 'x', name: '', size: 2, fixed:true }); } //Create Label for Data 2 var txt = board.create('text', [{#xmin#}+1, {#maxfreq2#}/2+2, "Machine 2"], { fontSize: 20,fixed: true }); //Create points of Data Set 1 var lx1 = {#dorx1#}; var ly1 = {#dory1#}; var i = 0; for (i = 0; i <= lx1.length - 1; i++) { p[i] = board.create('point', [lx1[i], ly1[i]], { face: 'x', name: '', size: 2, fixed:true }); } //Create Label for Data 1 var txt = board.create('text', [{#xmin#}+1, {#maxfreq1#}/2+{#maxfreq2#} + 5, "Machine 1"], { fontSize: 20,fixed: true }); [[/jsxgraph]]

What is the combined mean of the both datasets? [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

What is the combined standard deviation of the both datasets [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]]

generalfeedback.text: The outlier will increase the standard deviation, but not by this much. (Think about x̅ ± s and x̅ ± 2s.
